actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_youtube_comments.description: Fetch comments from  YouTube video with options to sort and limit results.
actions.get_youtube_comments.props.limit: The number of comments to retrieve (default is 10, maximum is 100).
actions.get_youtube_comments.props.sortB: The sorting order for the comments.
actions.get_youtube_comments.props.url.d: The URL of the YouTube video to fetch comments from. (e.g., https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID)
actions.get_youtube_details.description: Get detailed information about any YouTube video including title, description, view count, likes, dislikes, duration, and channel information.
actions.get_youtube_details.props.url.de: The URL of the YouTube video you want to get details from. (e.g., https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID)
actions.get_youtube_summary.description: Generates an AI-powered summary of a YouTube video.
actions.get_youtube_summary.props.url.de: The URL of the YouTube video to summarize. (e.g., https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID)
actions.get_youtube_transcript.descripti: Extract the full transcript with timestamps from any YouTube video that has captions or subtitles available.
actions.get_youtube_transcript.props.url: The URL of the YouTube video to get the transcript from. (e.g., https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID)
